text:
Let me consider this question about Edward VIII's abdication.

Edward VIII became King of the United Kingdom in January 1936 following the death of his father, George V. He abdicated in December 1936 to marry Wallis Simpson, an American divorcée, which created a constitutional crisis. His abdication took effect on December 11, 1936, and he was succeeded by his brother, who became George VI.

The majority of agents (3 out of 4) answered 1936 with very high confidence (0.97-1.00), while one agent answered 1937 with lower confidence (0.92). The historical record is clear that the abdication occurred in 1936, not 1937. Agent 1 may have confused the year with when Edward VIII left Britain or some other related event.

Answer: 1936
Confidence: 1.00
